name: lyfusion-plugin
description: A dual-agent collaboration plugin for Claude Code. Lily's personal project, not an official Anthropic product. Claude acts as lead for exploration, planning, review, and acceptance; Codex CLI acts as the assistant for coding, tests, and lint. Supports models available in Codex CLI, defaults to gpt-6-luna (high), and switches models with /fusion model. Requires Python 3, Git, and an authenticated Codex CLI installation.
